name: Island Terrain 3D Model
notes: Textured 3D island terrain (mountains + ocean floor) built from an elevation-contour guideline PDF and a satellite texture. Units meters, altitude on +Y, sea level Y=0. Contour elevation scheme: domain edge -1500m (ocean floor), coastline 0m, red +500, bright-red +1000, mountain peak +1500. Smooth distance-transform interpolation between contours; peak pinned to exactly +1500, floor -1500. Watertight terrain tile (surface + skirt + base), planar-projected satellite texture. Default horizontal extent ~18.8x20km (TARGET_MAX_EXTENT_M, editable). Outputs OBJ+MTL+PNG and GLB. Verified watertight, elevation range exactly -1500..1500.
